dataSafetyInference.basis: Products/services sharing and Google signals are off, Google Ads/AdMob link lists are empty. Technical support is processing on behalf; modeling UI explicitly scopes its input to aggregate/de-identified data; Recommendations refers to account administration data rather than game-player events.
dataSafetyInference.limits: Reasoned declaration recommendation, not contractual certainty or proof of every possible integration. Reassess when links/sharing settings or SDK behavior change. Distinct AdMob ad-interaction data may still be shared and must be disclosed separately.
dataSafetyInference.confidence: Supported scoped inference from inspected settings and primary documentation, not contractual certainty.

primaryPolicySources.relevance: Developer-instructed service-provider transfers and fully anonymized data transfers are excluded from sharing disclosure.
Analytics disclosure depends on SDK invocation and optional Google signals, Ads links, and Google products/services sharing.

Modeling data is aggregated so organization/account/users cannot be identified; technical support accesses data to resolve service issues; Recommendations concerns Analytics account administration data. Google products/services sharing would make Google an independent controller, and it is off here.
